channel.title: WristVox Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for WristVox Mac

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.0

  • iPhone: Full-screen Touchpad mode — move the cursor and scroll with multi-touch gestures, just like a laptop trackpad
  • iPhone: New D-Pad layout matching Apple Watch — orb, segments, and mode button for a unified experience
  • iPhone: Right Click support — long press or dedicated button for context menus
  • iPhone & Watch: Contextual Escape button — sends Escape when idle (stop Claude, close dialogs), switches to Stop during dictation
  • iPhone & Watch: Punctuation buttons — quickly insert comma, period, exclamation mark, and question mark
  • New BLE commands: Touchpad Move, Touchpad Scroll (multi-byte for smooth input), Right Click, Escape
  • Improved: Stop command now uses single Fn press — never accidentally starts dictation
